translations.spaces.triggers.title: Triggers & events
translations.spaces.triggers.description: Let another system hand this Space a goal, and tell another system what happened to its tasks. A goal that arrives is planned like one you typed, and its steps wait for your Start one level sooner than yours do.

translations.spaces.triggers.inbound.lead: Another system posts a signed event; the Mission Station receives it as a goal, plans it, and holds steps with real consequences for your Start.
